name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
summary: The Horde seeks to secure its ownership of Warsong Gulch. Your help supports that claim.

sections.title: A Claim in the Gulch
sections.body: The Horde's claim to Warsong Gulch is at stake, and you lend your strength to secure it. Your efforts help ensure the Horde keeps ownership of the gulch.

faq.q: What is happening at Warsong Gulch?
aliases: what's going on in the gulch
faq.answer: The Horde is seeking to ensure its ownership of Warsong Gulch.
You are helping the Horde secure its ownership of Warsong Gulch.
The Horde seeks to maintain ownership of Warsong Gulch.
